description: This file defines a DelegatingWorker class that delegates work to other CoroutineWorker instances created via dependency injection using Hilt. It includes an Hilt entry point interface for obtaining the HiltWorkerFactory, metadata handling for worker class identification, and the DelegatingWorker class that dynamically delegates tasks.

classes.name: HiltWorkerFactoryEntryPoint
classes.description: Hilt entry point interface to retrieve HiltWorkerFactory at runtime, installed in SingletonComponent.

classes.name: DelegatingWorker
classes.description: A CoroutineWorker that delegates its work to another worker obtained via HiltDI, allowing dynamic delegation based on input data.

methods.name: delegatedData
methods.description: Creates a Data object carrying the qualified name of the worker class for delegation.

methods.name: getForegroundInfo
methods.description: Delegates to the wrapped worker's getForegroundInfo method.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Delegates to the wrapped worker's doWork method.
